title: Plant Pest And Disease Management
modules: Introduction To Pest Management And Population Dynamics (Concepts)
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are a type of bacteria that lack distinct cell walls."
Phytoplasmas are a type of bacteria that lack distinct cell walls.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a result of sound genetic stock and optimal growing conditions."
Good plant vigour is a result of sound genetic stock and optimal growing conditions.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to the sterilization of males by Xrays or γ-rays and is called the sterile- male technique; control of a pest by this technique is termed autocide."
Sterilization This usually refers to the sterilization of males by Xrays or γ-rays and is called the sterile- male technique; control of a pest by this technique is termed autocide.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the visible reactions of a plant to a disease and may suggest a causal agent."
Symptoms of Diseases Symptoms are the visible reactions of a plant to a disease and may suggest a causal agent.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is one of the cruciferous root crops and will tolerate considerable leaf damage, but even slight Cabbage Root Fly damage may spoil the appearance of the root."
Turnip is one of the cruciferous root crops and will tolerate considerable leaf damage, but even slight Cabbage Root Fly damage may spoil the appearance of the root.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the population density of an increasing pest population, at which control measures should be started to prevent the population from reaching the economic injury level."
The economic threshold is the population density of an increasing pest population, at which control measures should be started to prevent the population from reaching the economic injury level.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the ideal method to manage plant diseases, if plants of satisfactory quality and adapted to the growing region with adequate levels of durable resistance are available."

Resistance Use of disease-resistant plants is the ideal method to manage plant diseases, if plants of satisfactory quality and adapted to the growing region with adequate levels of durable resistance are available.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as any measure that prevents the introduction of a disease-causing agent (pathogen) into a region or farm."
Exclusion This principle is defined as any measure that prevents the introduction of a disease-causing agent (pathogen) into a region or farm.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the simplest of the tests extensively used for the detection of viruses."
Grow out test is the simplest of the tests extensively used for the detection of viruses.
fib: ______ is the application of chemicals to an infected or diseased plant that stops (i.e., eradicates) the infection.
Chemotherapy
Chemotherapy is the application of chemicals to an infected or diseased plant that stops (i.e., eradicates) the infection.
______ is any organism that can cause a disease.
pathogen
Causal Agents of Disease A pathogen is any organism that can cause a disease.
______ is the term used when a crop shows a continuous gradation between resistant plants and susceptible plants within the population, with no clear-cut distinction between the two types.
Quantitative resistance

Quantitative resistance is the term used when a crop shows a continuous gradation between resistant plants and susceptible plants within the population, with no clear-cut distinction between the two types.
______ is the term used when the character is controlled by several genes acting in concert.
Oligogenic resistance
Oligogenic resistance is the term used when the character is controlled by several genes acting in concert.
______ is a frequently used strategy to reduce the quantity of a pathogen, usually soil- borne organisms, in a cropping area.
Crop rotation
Crop rotation is a frequently used strategy to reduce the quantity of a pathogen, usually soil- borne organisms, in a cropping area.
______ is the result of many genes, and is clearly more difficult to incorporate into a plant breeding programme.
Polygenic resistance
Polygenic resistance is the result of many genes, and is clearly more difficult to incorporate into a plant breeding programme.
______ are the visible parts of the pathogen or its products seen on the host that can be used to identify the pathogen.
Signs
Signs of Diseases Signs are the visible parts of the pathogen or its products seen on the host that can be used to identify the pathogen.
______ is any part of the pathogen that can cause infection.
Inoculum
Inoculum and Pathogen Dissemination Inoculum is any part of the pathogen that can cause infection.
______ are responsible for producing antibiotics and apparently about 300 antibiotics do show some promise as pesticides; these act directly as killing agents or inhibitors of growth or reproduction.
Fungi
Fungi are responsible for producing antibiotics and apparently about 300 antibiotics do show some promise as pesticides; these act directly as killing agents or inhibitors of growth or reproduction.
